tasks.short: Confer with contractors and agencies on the works

steps.what: Send comments on the specification and the schedule
Send agency comments on plans and specifications
Build the agenda from comments that have an id

loop.input: comment rows and the agenda template
loop.output: agenda lines that each cite a comment id
loop.check: Every line cites a comment id that arrived from the contractor or the agency
loop.stop: One pass, then leave off any comment with no id
loop.why_not_simpler: Comment text is free and a fixed sort cannot write the agenda line

steps.what: Confer on plans, specifications and work schedules
Draft the decision note from closed comment ids

loop.input: closed comment ids and the note template
loop.output: note that closes only those ids
loop.check: Every closed id was on the agenda, and no new specification point is added
loop.stop: One pass, then stop if no comment was marked closed
loop.why_not_simpler: The wording of an agreement is not a fixed sentence for a comment id

steps.what: Sign the conference decision note
Send the signed note to the parties

tasks.design: Contractors and the agency reviewer send comment ids by {EMAIL}. A {DOCS} agenda lists only comments that have an id. The conference stays a meeting. The decision note closes those ids, the transportation engineer signs it, and the signed note is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comments arrived as long mail with no id, so a note could not say which specification point had been closed.
tasks.enabler_now: A comment can carry an id, a party and a schedule activity id that an agenda can list without reading the whole thread.
tasks.still_hard: The conference itself is a conversation with contractors and agencies. The note does not hold it.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer conducts the conference and decides which comments are closed.

ambition.what: Close comment ids in a signed note the same day, instead of a later mail chain

tasks.altitude: Preparation is shorter. The engineer still spends the conference in the room and still signs what was agreed.

reach.task: Update the work schedule from the signed note
reach.learn: Which comment ids are closed and which schedule activities moved

evidence.claim: Conferring on plans and schedules is a meeting. In a mid-size firm the reusable part is the agenda and the written close, not the conversation.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a date or a quantity in the decision note is kept only when it cites a comment id.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed decision note is sent. Doing the construction is the contractor's later work.

Input contract: meeting id, party, comment id, specification section, schedule activity id. Producer is the contractor or the agency reviewer. Utility companies use the same supplier comment form. A comment with no id stays in the meeting and is not listed on the agenda.
Use the mailbox and the document template before custom code. The conference is not turned into a system record.
The hours prior is meetings and mail. These steps keep the conference and only move the agenda and the note.
unknowns: Whether utility companies will use the comment form or still telephone.
Who may close a comment that changes the contract sum.
Which schedule is the record, the engineer's or the contractor's.
research_questions: What share of conference comments have no specification section?
How often is the decision note still rewritten the next day?

already_counted.description: Engineer edits agenda lines that misread a comment
Conference time stays with the engineer
Signature time on the note stays in the review

incremental.description: Keep the comment form aligned with new specification sections
Contractor resubmits comments the agenda rejected

approvals.approved_version: conference decision note signed for this meeting id
the same signed conference decision note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes comments stay as free-text mail, so the agenda is typed by hand and the conference is unchanged. The high case assumes comment ids exist, while the meeting and the signature stay. Work on site is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present maps and counts at a public hearing

steps.what: Assemble maps and count tables for the hearing
Draft speaker notes that cite those tables

loop.input: map sheet ids, count tables and the note template
loop.output: speaker notes that cite those ids
loop.check: Every count in the notes equals a cell on a listed table
loop.stop: One pass, then drop a sentence with no sheet or table id
loop.why_not_simpler: How a point is explained to a public room is not a fixed line

steps.what: Sign the hearing pack before the meeting
Present the pack at the public hearing
Record questions asked at the public hearing
Note the hearing on the agency file

tasks.design: Maps and count tables already in {DOCS} are assembled into a hearing pack. Speaker notes may cite only those tables. The transportation engineer signs the pack and presents it in person at the public hearing. The hearing is not a plan check and is not replaced by one.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hearing slides were copied from old files, so a figure on the screen could differ from the signed map.
tasks.enabler_now: A map sheet id and a count table id can be required on every speaker note before the pack is signed.
tasks.still_hard: Standing in the hearing and answering people is the task. A pack does not do it.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer presents and answers. Nothing is said that the signed pack does not contain.
tasks.altitude: Pack preparation is shorter. The hearing stays an in-person duty, and the engineer can refuse to present an unsigned pack.

reach.task: File the hearing on the agency record
reach.learn: Which pack version was signed and which questions were recorded

evidence.claim: A construction hearing is in person. In a mid-size firm the engineer presents maps and counts, and the reusable part is the pack, not the room.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a count in the speaker notes is kept only when it cites a table.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when questions from the hearing are recorded. Changing the design because of the hearing is later.

Input contract: hearing id, map sheet id, count table id, question id. Producer of the maps and tables is the signed project record. A note that cites a missing table id is dropped. The hearing itself is not a form.
Use the document template before custom code. The presentation stays manual.
The hours prior is mostly the hearing. These steps do not treat that time as saved. A coded plan check is a different task and is not used here.
unknowns: Whether the authority requires the engineer to present in person.
Which map version the agency will accept.
How questions from the floor are recorded today.
research_questions: How often does a hearing figure differ from the signed table?
What share of hearing time is the presentation versus the questions?

already_counted.description: Engineer edits speaker notes before the signature
Hearing time stays with the engineer in the room
Recording questions stays with the engineer

incremental.description: Update the speaker-note template when the authority changes the hearing format

approvals.approved_version: hearing pack signed for this hearing id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes maps are not identified, so the pack is still assembled by hand and the hearing is unchanged. The high case assumes sheet ids exist, while the presentation and the answers stay. Redesign after the hearing is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare final layout drawings with stress figures

steps.what: Enter loads, spans and section sizes
Compute the stress figures on the sheet
Check each stress figure cites a cell
Draw the final layout on the sheets
Run coded clash rules on the layout
Read clash hits against the drawing
Sign the layout drawing
File the signed layout drawing

tasks.design: Loads, spans and stress figures stay on the {SPREADSHEET}, and a figure with no cell id is not placed on the drawing. The transportation engineer draws the final layout. Coded clash rules in {DOCS} mark conflicts. The engineer signs the drawing. A machine does not stamp it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stress figures were typed onto drawings from memory, so a sheet could not show which calculation cell they came from.
tasks.enabler_now: Each stress figure can be required to cite a cell id before it is allowed onto the drawing note.
tasks.still_hard: The stress calculation and the drawing are still the engineer's work. A clash list is not a structural check.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer computes the stress, draws the layout and signs. A machine does not stamp the drawing.
tasks.altitude: Less time hunting a missing cell reference. The calculation, the drawing and the signature do not move.

reach.task: Read clash hits on a layout drawing
reach.learn: Which stress figures cite a cell and which clash rules fired

evidence.claim: A final layout drawing in a mid-size firm is still drawn by the engineer. The stress sheet is a workbook, and the stamp is a signature.
Digest [S4] says a civil-site design product announced generative layout help. That help is design drafting only, and a person still signs. It does not check stress calculations.
Digest [S5] says a model-checking product for building models runs coded rules. That fits a clash check on the layout, not the stress calculation and not a public hearing.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a stress figure is placed on the drawing only when it cites a cell.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed layout drawing is filed. The structural calculation method is the engineer's and is not replaced.

Input contract: sheet id, member id, load case, stress value, unit, calculation cell id. Producer is the engineer on the calculation sheet. A stress value with no cell id is not copied onto the drawing.
Configure coded clash rules in the document store before custom code. Those rules do not compute stress. Native drawing tools stay as they are.
The hours prior splits across the screen and the spreadsheet. Both remain, because the drawing and the stress sheet are different means.
unknowns: Which members must always be calculated by hand.
Whether a second discipline signs the stress sheet.
Which clash rules the authority actually requires.
research_questions: What share of stress figures on issued drawings have no cell id?
How often does a clash rule fire on a layout the engineer then keeps?

already_counted.description: Stress calculation time stays with the engineer
Drawing time stays with the engineer
Signature time stays on the drawing review

incremental.description: Update clash rules when a drawing standard changes
Design checker rereads a sheet after a stress figure changes

approvals.approved_version: layout drawing signed for this sheet id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes calculations are unstructured, so the cell check rarely fires and the engineer still draws every sheet. The high case assumes cell ids exist, while the stress calculation, the drawing and the signature stay. Issuing for construction beyond the filing is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate a traffic problem and recommend a method

steps.what: Read volume, delay and crash rows
Judge the traffic problem on site
Choose a method for flow or safety
Draft the recommendation from that method

loop.input: chosen method id and count rows
loop.output: recommendation that names only that method
loop.check: The method id matches the choice, and every volume or crash count cites a row
loop.stop: Stop if the method id is missing, and do not draft a second method
loop.why_not_simpler: Why this method fits the site is not a fixed sentence for a count

steps.what: Check the method against the programme
Sign the traffic recommendation
File the signed traffic recommendation

tasks.design: Volume, delay and crash rows for the site are on {BI}. The transportation engineer judges the traffic problem on site and chooses the method. A {DOCS} recommendation is drafted only for that method, with each count tagged to a row. The engineer signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations were essays with counts typed from memory, so a later reader could not tell which method had been chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: The count export can key volume, delay and crash count to a site id, and the engineer can name a method id before the text is drafted.
tasks.still_hard: Judging why the traffic fails, and which method is fit, is not a threshold on the count.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the method on site. The note may not propose a different one.

ambition.what: Recommend from a fresh count when delay or crashes move, not only in the annual study

tasks.altitude: Less time rebuilding the count table. The site judgement and the choice of method stay with the engineer.

reach.task: Put a signed traffic method on the programme
reach.learn: Which method id was chosen and which count rows it cites

evidence.claim: Investigating a traffic problem is a site visit plus a written method. In a mid-size firm the counts can be tabulated, and the method cannot.
Digest [S12] and [S13] say safety components in road traffic can be high-risk under the EU AI Act. A model does not decide this safety method. The transportation engineer still signs.
Digest [S20] says a research paper was withdrawn because the institution did not trust the data, so a volume or crash count in the recommendation must cite a row.

assumptions: Focal role is the transportation engineer. The task ends when the signed recommendation is filed. Building the method is later. This task does not run a traffic simulation.

Input contract: site id, peak volume, delay minutes, crash count, method id. Producer of the counts is the operations export. The method id is produced by the engineer after the site visit. No method id means no recommendation is drafted.
Use the dashboard's own filters before custom code. The site visit and the choice stay manual.
The hours prior mixes site time and documents. The site visit stays. Only the count read and the draft move.
unknowns: Which sites have a trustworthy delay count.
Who else must agree a method that changes a signal.
Whether the programme can hold a method id.
research_questions: What share of recommendations cite a count that is more than a year old?
How often does the signed method differ from the first draft?

already_counted.description: Site judgement time stays with the engineer
Engineer edits the recommendation before signing
Signature time stays on the recommendation

incremental.description: Add a method code when a new treatment is allowed
Project controller updates the programme comment after a method change

approvals.approved_version: traffic method chosen for this site id
traffic recommendation signed for this method id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes counts are not keyed to a site, so the engineer still assembles them and still visits. The high case assumes rows are clean, while the site judgement, the method choice and the signature stay. A simulation run is not part of this task and is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Conferences and hearings stay, while agendas, packs and drawing notes stop being rewritten from scratch.
reach: The contractor receives a signed decision note that closes comment ids instead of a loose mail thread.
The agency reviewer receives the hearing pack that was signed before the meeting.
skills_to_grow: Turn comments into ids an agenda can list.
Keep a stress figure tied to the cell that produced it.
Choose a traffic method before any recommendation text is drafted.
role.ambitious_version: A conference ends with a signed note the same day, and a layout drawing is filed only with stress figures that cite the sheet.
